question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

To pick somebody's pocket

options.text: To make a very difficult choice
To steal something from the pocket

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"To pick somebody's pocket"** means to steal something from someone's pocket without them noticing. (किसी की जेब से चोरी करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The thief managed **to pick the tourist's pocket** in the crowded market without getting caught.
 
 
 
• **"To steal" **means to take another person's property without permission or legal right and without intending to return it. (चोरी करना)
 
 
• **Example: **He was caught **stealing** a watch from the store.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the phrase **'To pick somebody's pocket' **means **'To steal something from the pocket'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To make a very difficult choice **(बहुत कठिन विकल्प चुनना): To decide between two or more difficult options.

 
 
• **Example:** He had** to make a very difficult choice** between his career and his family.
 
 
 
• **To choose wisely **(समझदारी से चुनना): To make a good decision based on careful thought and judgment.
 
 
• **Example: **She** chose wisely** to invest her money in real estate.
 
 
 
• **To cry for financial help** (आर्थिक मदद के लिए रोना): To desperately seek monetary assistance.
 
 
• **Example:** After losing his job, he was left **to cry for financial help** from his friends and family.
 
 

34:Tc1e,

The correct answer is **Option 1)**
